name: sc-725
description: Audio Database * The tape deck is sold separately. National/Technics SC-725 ¥ 92,800 (around 1970) Commentary A stereo set designed to balance performance. Receiver section The SEPP-OTL circuit is used for the amplifier. The preamp section and main amplifier section can be used independently. A 4-pole MOS FET is used for the FM tuner section. Equipped with FM-AM tuning meter stereo eye. Player part The cartridge is a semiconductor cartridge. Speaker part 3-way configuration. A 20 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. In addition, it is equipped with a 9 cm cone scoker for the middle range and a 6.5 cm cone tweeter for the high range. The enclosure is hermetically sealed. Other There was an interior box as an option sold separately in SC-725. This interior box was also sold as SC-725 Deluxe as a set. The interior box can be used as a record shelf or tape deck storage rack. It can be developed into a multi-amplifier system by adding a multi-channel divider (sold separately).
